questions.text: The 6-digit number A678B3 is divisible by 3. Find the least possible value of (A+B). Ans A). 1 B). 4 C). 7 D). 3 Correct Answer: D

In a logistics network, the numbers of parcels delivered respectively by Hub X and Hub Y are in the ratio 13 : 21. If Hub X delivers 160 more parcels and Hub Y delivers 240 more parcels, the ratio becomes 15 : 23. How many parcels were originally delivered by Hub X? Ans A). 85 B). 65 C). 75 D). 55 Correct Answer: B
Three solid spheres each of radius 7 cm are melted to form a cylinder of radius 7 cm. What is the height of the cylinder? Ans A). 30 cm B). 28 cm C). 32 cm D). 34 cm Correct Answer: B

A, B, and C can complete a project alone in 12 days, 18 days, and 24 days, respectively. If they all work together for 4 days, what fraction of the project will remain incomplete? Ans A). B). C). D). Correct Answer: D

The sum of the ages of Riya's father and Ayushi's brother is 48 years. Find the sum of the ages (in years) of Ayushi and Riya. Ans A). 23 B). 18 C). 21 D). 14 Correct Answer: B

A school organised a science exhibition where projects were evaluated out of 50 marks. The average score of Physics projects was 42 and that of Computer Science projects was 46. If the overall average score of all 40 projects was 44.5, find the number of Physics projects presented in the exhibition. Ans A). 14 B). 18 C). 15 D). 12 Correct Answer: C
